brief:
Al Jazeera English reports that critics accuse Israel of causing ecological damage across Palestinian territories despite environmental messaging. The outlet's coverage examines what it characterizes as contradictions between Israel's green initiatives and its impact on Palestinian ecosystems and resources.

The reporting frames environmental degradation as a consequence of Israeli policies affecting Palestinian land use and ecological systems in the occupied territories.
dek: For all its greenwashing, the Zionist state has ecologically devastated Palestine more than anyone else.
title: Israel's environmental policies devastate Palestinian lands, critics say
